data_origin: AI-authored response features, not DVWA HTTP captures
profile_orders: all six permutations, balanced within eligible technique
retrieval: frozen Nomic cosine ranking reused only for exactly matching label-free technique/injection-point queries
B3_limit: all three eligible chunks, complete technique context; no ranking-selectivity attribution
reference_labels: contract-derived AI labels outside requests, pending researcher review
input_gate: schema must pass; runtime_status=valid AND baseline_valid=true before every model call
budget: recount every locked request with pinned tokenizer; abort whole execution before first call on excess; never trim
execution: one sequential session, no resume or repeating any started slot under this run directory
content_errors: missing content, invalid JSON/schema, unknown observation ID, unfinished generation, runtime length stop, or conservative output-budget rejection => analysis_error and continue
transport_errors: record attempt as analysis_error and halt session without retry; all remaining valid slots unattempted
prompt_count_mismatch: analysis_error on attempted case; halt session, retain raw response
interruption: persist attempt_started before call; unmatched started attempt is interrupted analysis_error; never silently rerun
semantic_audit: retain schema-valid raw decision even if tally, reason, references or trial logic contradict; report warnings separately

primary.numerator: attempted eligible cases with schema-valid raw decision equal to reference decision
primary.denominator: all attempted eligible cases per profile, including analysis errors and interrupted attempts
primary.pairing: paired correctness difference across all 36 identical eligible inputs; any missing attempt makes conclusion incomplete
primary.direction: B3 accuracy minus A accuracy, percentage points

companions: binary coverage on all attempted cases and separately on binary-reference cases
trial accuracy using all expected available trials, including trials in errored attempts
reason code reference accuracy and internal consistency, semantic warning count, durations, tokens, completion
paired A/B3 correctness transitions with case IDs
coverage: positive/negative non-error decisions divided by all attempted eligible cases; inconclusive is abstention
trial_scoring: each expected available trial scores 1 only for exactly one assessment with correct outcome; missing/duplicate/errored trial scores 0

conclusion_rule.prerequisite: all 108 eligible slots attempted and finalized, no input gate violations
conclusion_rule.improvement_on_this_dataset: B3 raw accuracy > A raw accuracy, with positive correct count not lower, negative false-positive count not higher, binary-reference coverage not lower, and analysis-error count not higher
conclusion_rule.tradeoff: accuracy increases but at least one companion guard worsens
conclusion_rule.no_improvement: B3 raw accuracy <= A raw accuracy
conclusion_rule.incomplete: any planned eligible attempt missing or unfinished; descriptive attempted denominators only

formal_metrics: does not replace proposal FPR ablation or PSR LLM/SecLists, and does not change R1/R2/R3
review_basis: forwarded review; authorship/independence and researcher adoption not established

output_completion.generation-length-limit: done=true and done_reason=length; runtime reports a length stop
output_completion.unexpected-completion-reason: done=true with a reason other than stop or length
output_completion.invalid-generation-token-count: non-integer, boolean, missing or nonpositive eval_count
output_completion.output-budget-rejection: done=true, done_reason=stop, integer eval_count >= 768; conservative budget policy, not proof of incomplete JSON
output_completion.accepted_runtime_metadata: done=true, done_reason=stop, 0 < eval_count < 768; content must also pass JSON/schema and known-ID checks
output_completion.precedence: prompt-count mismatch, unfinished, runtime length stop, other completion reason, invalid token count, budget rejection, content/schema, unknown ID

structural_errors: missing required field, invalid JSON/schema, or any nonexistent observation ID => analysis_error; verdict/trials get no credit and the attempted-case denominator remains
semantic_warnings: existing IDs with wrong/missing support, missing/duplicate expected trial entries within a schema-valid array, wrong trial outcome, tally/reason/feedback contradiction => warning only; keep raw verdict
reason_code_accuracy: code equals the code for the reference decision and technique; denominator all attempted eligible cases, including errors
reason_code_consistency: code agrees with the model's own raw decision and technique; denominator all attempted eligible cases, including errors; this is not reference accuracy
paired_transitions: A/B3 wrong-to-correct, correct-to-wrong, both-correct and both-wrong, with case IDs; analysis errors count as wrong, unmatched starts as interrupted errors; report missing and unfinished pairs separately
coverage_limits: runtime-invalid dataset cases have empty observations; full-positive runtime-invalid input is not represented in the 42 cases
baseline-invalid dataset flags agree with baseline diagnostics; contradictory upstream flags are not represented
input gate validates schema and trusts runtime_status/baseline_valid supplied upstream; it does not independently establish flag/diagnostic consistency
upstream executor is responsible for deriving truthful runtime/baseline validity from its checks; this pilot does not verify that derivation end to end
four positive boolean cases mainly vary accepted HTTP 200/404 patterns; mechanism diversity is limited
pilot-032 combines control diagnostics and negative timing delta; use per-trial assessments for diagnosis
